data.title: Sunday Resets: When’s the right time to cut them off? 🤔✂️
data.summary: The topic of discussion is relationships–friendship, romantic, family, professional–and when the right time to cut folks off is (if ever). Before you go off for Thanksgiving break, join us to dig into this real discussion. Boba will be available while supplies last

data.title: Weekly SCR Dinner Table
data.summary: Join members of Winthrop’s Senior Common Room for dinner, almost every Sunday in Fall 2026 (last dinner is on Sunday Dec 13, 2026). Interesting people, interesting conversations! All are welcome.

data.title: Wellness Wheel & Cookie Dough!
data.summary: Join Winthrop non-resident tutor Liz Kaye (Winthrop ’21) to reflect on your well-being by filling out a “Wellness Wheel” and identify areas you’d like to strengthen, all while enjoying yummy cookie dough with toppings!

data.title: Sonny Side Up
